offers_products.reason: Wholesale distributes pool supplies, chemicals, equipment, replacement parts, irrigation and outdoor living products from 200,000+ items.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is from distributing goods; delivery and advice are incidental to product sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Wholesale only; sells to pool contractors and retailers, not directly to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to pool builders, service companies, retailers, irrigation contractors and commercial aquatic facilities.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most sales are repeat orders of chemicals, replacement parts and maintenance supplies by pool service customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Mostly maintenance chemicals and repair parts are non-discretionary, though new pool construction and remodel sales are cyclical.

big_ticket.reason: Typical orders are frequent, small supplies like chemicals and parts, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: A product distributor; customers pay for goods and availability, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are many small pool contractors, service firms and independent retailers, not large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Distribution model with leased service centers and delivery trucks; inventory-heavy but not capital-intensive.

notes: Maintenance demand is stable, but new construction and remodel sales are cyclical.
